about: Have a health professional's qualifications assessed before a MOHAP licence.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHAP service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: No gap in practice longer than three years
Qualification accredited in the country of origin
Valid passport; blacklisted candidates cannot apply
Non-English certificates need a legal translation
documents: Experience certificate, professional licence and good conduct certificate (optional for new graduates)
fees: TCAM and allied health 300 AED each
